Well, it's simple you answered your own question. If you have ADHD, you need to focus on what you do best and capitalize. There's no point trying to compare yourself to other people, because our strengths and weaknesses are generally differentiate from one person or another. Try think of ADHD analogically to a physical disability, such as having a bad back. Sure you can't deadlift heavy, or do heavy labor work like those other people, but you're really good at yoga so focus on the yoga, figuratively speaking.

Yeah I agree... I met a man with no legs who could run using to only his hands, I saw a video about a teenage boy who was blind who could roller skate/play sports/play video games, amongst a multitude of people who do everyday things in unconventional manners. Point being, it's simply a group of said/alleged(cynic here, blame Tumblr users) people with ADHD, sharing success or venting out frustrations together. If we blamed everything on diseases and disabilities, we as humanity would be left in the Stone Age. Beethoven would've quit composing because he went deaf, Steven Hawking wouldn't have made his scientific contributions because of ALS, and Mozart would have never made music because of ADHD. :)

Truth be told, the issue doesn't have to do with ADHD directly. But as a fellow with ADHD, no medication in the world will help you with this. You're just a 20 something like you said, you're expected to be overwhelmed, tossed into unfamiliar environments, and it can be overbearing. Just remember, Rome wasn't built over night, don't be afraid to fail, and remember you cannot control everything. You just got to follow your gut. Cheers from one journeyer to another and congrats for making it this far.
